list.name: run_id
list.label: Run ID
list.query: SELECT run_id FROM house_metrics GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY MAX(time) DESC

list.name: house_id
list.label: House
list.query: SELECT house_id FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' GROUP BY house_id ORDER BY MAX(time) DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", actual_load, reconstructed_load FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

WITH points AS (SELECT time, e_h, (${delta_h_w})::double precision AS delta_h FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT time AS "time", 'E_H' AS metric, e_h AS value FROM points UNION ALL SELECT time AS "time", '+Delta_H' AS metric, delta_h AS value FROM points UNION ALL SELECT time AS "time", '-Delta_H' AS metric, -delta_h AS value FROM points ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT time AS "time", tr FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS "time", sqrt(avg(e_h * e_h)) AS rmse_1m FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT avg(tr) AS value FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time)
SELECT sqrt(avg(e_h * e_h)) AS value FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY abs(e_h)) AS value FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time)
SELECT avg(CASE WHEN abs(e_h) > (${delta_h_w})::double precision THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float AS value FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT run_id, house_id, count(*) AS rows, min(time) AS start_time, max(time) AS end_time, round(avg(tr)::numeric, 4) AS avg_tr, round(sqrt(avg(e_h * e_h))::numeric, 4) AS rmse, round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY abs(e_h))::numeric, 4) AS p95_abs_eh FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY run_id, house_id ORDER BY house_id
SELECT round((100.0 * avg(tr))::numeric, 2) AS value FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time)
SELECT round((100.0 * (1.0 - avg(tr)))::numeric, 2) AS value FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time)

panels.title: Transmission Rate: With vs Without System

targets.rawSql: WITH buckets AS (SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS bucket, 100.0 * avg(tr) AS with_system FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) SELECT bucket AS "time", 'With system' AS metric, with_system AS value FROM buckets UNION ALL SELECT bucket AS "time", 'Without system' AS metric, 100.0 AS value FROM buckets ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH current_run AS (SELECT avg(tr) AS avg_tr FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT 'Without system (full transmission)' AS scenario, 100.0 AS transmission_rate_pct, 0.0 AS reduction_pct FROM current_run UNION ALL SELECT 'With system (' || '$run_id' || ')' AS scenario, round((100.0 * avg_tr)::numeric, 2) AS transmission_rate_pct, round((100.0 * (1.0 - avg_tr))::numeric, 2) AS reduction_pct FROM current_run

SELECT run_id || ' / house ' || house_id AS metric, avg(tr) AS tr, sqrt(avg(e_h * e_h)) AS rmse FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id <> 'default' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY run_id, house_id ORDER BY run_id, house_id

SELECT run_id || ' / house ' || house_id AS metric, avg(tr) AS tr, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY abs(e_h)) AS p95_abs_eh FROM house_metrics WHERE run_id <> 'default' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY run_id, house_id ORDER BY run_id, house_id
SELECT time AS "time", 'plug ' || plug_uid AS metric, delta_p AS value FROM threshold_log WHERE house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time, plug_uid
SELECT delta_p FROM threshold_log WHERE house_id = $house_id AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY delta_p
